🕵️‍♂️ Beregost Time-Loop Stakeout Mysteries (2 Optional Town Investigations)

Heard as aftermath on Loop 0 (at the 11:00 AM Muster) • Solved on a Later Loop by Staking Out the Crime Scene Before It Happens!
Time-Loop Detective Payoffs
🕵️‍♂️ Mystery 1: The 10:15 AM Cobbler's Lane Mugging (Old Morwen)
• How Players Learn of It (Aftermath, 10:30–11:00 AM): At the 11:00 AM Square Muster (or her shop), blind Old Granny Morwen nurses a bruised forehead: at 10:15 AM, as she took the shortcut through Cobbler's Lane carrying her Moon-Dew elixir basket, someone dropped a flour sack over her head from the rafters and mugged her! Because she is blind, she never saw the culprit.
• Later-Loop Stakeout (10:00–10:15 AM in Cobbler's Lane): Hiding in Cobbler's Lane (bldg_shadow_alley) before 10:15 AM catches Dredge (a Silt-Gull cutthroat, CR 1/2, 27 HP) dropping from the rain-barrel overhang to mug Morwen!
• 🎁 Loop Reward (Free Potions + Dawn Pass-Phrase): Morwen gifts a free Potion of Heroism (+10 Temp HP & +1d4 Bless for 1 hr, no concentration) + 2x Potions of Fire Resistance! She also shares her pass-phrase "Wintermint & Silver Dew" so on future loops the party can warn her at 06:05 AM and grab the potions right at dawn!
• 🔗 Small Connecting Clue: Dredge carries a note sealed with a backwards wax thumbprint paying 20 gp for "any brass tuning forks or Ulcaster rubbings," and blurts out that charmed killers are coming to this exact alley at 11:15 AM to murder Garrick the Fence!
🕵️‍♂️ Mystery 2: The 08:45 AM Smithy Yard Heist (Taerom's Oil)
• How Players Learn of It (Aftermath, 09:00–11:00 AM): Visiting Thunderhammer Smithy after 09:00 AM (or at the 11:00 AM Muster), Master Smith Taerom fumes that while he was out front shoeing caravan mules between 08:30 and 08:50 AM, a phantom thief climbed his back coal-wall at 08:45 AM, put his hound to sleep, and stole his Masterwork Weapon-Tempering Oil!
• Later-Loop Stakeout (08:35–08:45 AM at Smithy Yard): Staking out the back coal-yard of Thunderhammer Smithy (bldg_smithy) at 08:45 AM catches the thief red-handed: Vex, a young town courier walking in a glassy-eyed trance under a Suggestion spell!
• 🎁 Loop Reward (+1 Weapon Tempering + Healing Potion): Saving the kit lets Taerom coat 2 party weapons in Masterwork Adamantine & Silvered Oil (+1 to hit/damage & bypasses nonmagical B/P/S resistance for the loop) + gift a Potion of Greater Healing (plus pass-phrase "Moradin's Tongs" to claim at dawn on future loops)!
• 🔗 Small Connecting Clue: Snapped out of his trance, Vex gasps: "At 07:15 AM by the North Gate, that radiant angel Aurelius clapped my shoulder and told me to dump Taerom's oil down the Stonecrest cistern... Wait—when he touched me, his thumbs were on the wrong side of his hands, and he smelled of tiger fur!"

⚔️ BEREGOST TIME LOOP: MASTER CAMPAIGN COMPENDIUM

D&D 2024 (5.5e) | 5 Players (Level 7 → 11) | 12-Hour Fixed Operational Window (06:00 to 18:00) | 13-Session Campaign
Official DM Companion
⏳ The Core Loop Directive:

At 18:00 (or on party wipeout), an orbital solar resonance beam vaporizes Beregost, snapping the universe back to 06:00 AM. Only the 5 player characters retain memories and continuity. All NPCs, monsters, and celestials reset identically each cycle.

🧠 Progression via Knowledge & Soul Milestones:

Physical loot and gold reset to dawn positions. Progression relies on retained knowledge (passwords, true names, enemy stats, bypass routes) and Milestone Level-Ups awarded permanently upon slaying each Capstone Boss!

⏱️ Calibrated Travel & Investigation Time Rules

Universal Campaign Engine
🥾 1 Hex / Hr (60m)
Ground Travel (3+ Walkers)
1 hex/hr in general before the sun gets too hot
🦅 2 Hexes / Hr (30m)
Gryphon Flight (2 Riders, Max 2 Hrs)
Bone Whistle Gryphon carries 2 PCs for 2h (06:00–08:00 AM) before sky gets too hot; other 3 walk!
🔍 60 min
Standard Hex Investigation
Searching ruins, shrines, caches, or hermits
🏛️ 120 min (2 hrs)
Deep Dungeon Delve
Sunken Necropolis, Sea Caves, Glacial Chasm
⚠️ Split-Party Flight & Thermal Boundaries: Pike's Zephyr Bone Whistle summons Gryphon Zephyr, which can carry 2 players at double speed (2 hexes/hr, 30m/hex) for 2 hours (06:00–08:00 AM, 4 hexes max) before rising solar thermals make the sky too hot to fly! The other 3 players must walk (1 hex/hr, 60m/hex), creating a tactical pathing puzzle where flyers scout distant counter-items while walkers secure mid-range objectives before converging at the boss lair! Inner Red Loop (12:00 PM Solar Scorch) deals 2d6 fire/10m in open sun; Outer Red Loop (15:00 PM Cutoff) marks the maximum ground radius before 175°F ambient heat inflicts 10d6 fire/round outdoor.

👑 The 5 Bosses: 4 Capstone Guardians + The True Final Boss

CR 13 to 16 Progression

Hex (17,10) Glacial Frostpeak | 200 HP, AC 20

Hex (12,16) Sunken Necropolis (via 14,12) | 135 HP, AC 17

Boon: Golden Alabaster Tablets proving Celestial/Fiend soul swap & Milestone Level 10!

Disguised as Deva Aurelius; 1st-6th level spell immunity. Countered by Circlet of Mind Sanctity (9,7), Monocle of Truth (8,6), & Blessed Piercing Arrows (7,4).

Boon: Eradicates town sabotage, rescues True Angel in devil's body, & Milestone Level 11!

Hex (5,11) Commodore Reef Flats | 230 HP, 4 Abyssal Chains

Bound in saltwater chains unleashing 12d8 lightning. Rescued with The Commodore\'s Winch & Grounding Rod (4,11). Unchained rather than killed!

👑 TRUE FINAL BOSS: The Singing Devil (in the Angel's Body)

CR 16 Supreme Celestial/Fiend Hybrid | 240 HP | AC 19 | Fly 90 ft | Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8)
Unlocked After All 4 Capstones

The ancient Archdevil trapped in the radiant, feathered body of the True Angel who burned the party at the end of the Island Society campaign. Performs the apocalyptic solar ritual atop the Spire of the False Angel on the Western Sea Cliffs (Hex 6, 8), visible across the valley at sunset. The party, backed by the True Angel (in the horned Devil's body), storms the Spire under Otheus's summoned hurricane downdraft, battles the Singing Devil, channels the Inversion Reversal Rite from the Alabaster Tablets, restores their true bodies, and shatters the chronocite resonator to PERMANENTLY BREAK THE TIME LOOP!

🧞 The Genie Protocol (Zephyrus the Cloud-Lord)

Permanent Meta-Progression
📍 Shrine Location: The Aerie of the Four Winds at Hex (11, 12) (Southeastern alabaster mesa threshold).
🗣️ True Name: Zephyrus-Al-Mubarak (Discovered in White Dragon\'s hoard).
⏱️ Travel Cost: 4 hexes SE from Beregost = 4 hours on foot (06:00 to 10:00 AM) or 2 hours by early-day air (06:00 to 08:00 AM). Arrives 2 hours before 12:00 PM Solar Scorch!
Subsequent Loop Rules:

The party does NOT have to fight Rimefang again! When time resets, the Wish buff fades, but the party remembers the shrine coordinates and True Name. They travel to Hex (11,12), speak the command word, and claim 1 Active Wish for elemental resistance before tackling that day\'s boss!

🗺️ Complete 13-Session Campaign DM Roadmap

6 Narrative Acts | Level 7 to Level 11
ACT I: The Shock of Dawn & Beregost Under Siege Sessions 1–3 | Party Level 7
  • Session 1 (Loop 0): Arrival in Beregost; Old Jonas recites 8-line Solstice Prophecy at 06:00; morning carnival games (Sister Althea, Granny Morwen, Taerom, Tobias, Elorion & Pip); 3 morning heroic errands with 11:00 AM High Sun Muster hook (South cornfield scarecrow rescue at Hex 8,11; East watch scout patrol at Hex 9,10 with Snirk's dragon clue; West Gate barleyfield firebreak & Cinder Mephits at Hex 7,10); civilian bonds (Tobias, Maya, Rebecca); 15:00 bunker tragedy; 17:59 orbital vaporization.
  • Session 2 (Loop 1): Groundhog Day realization; Tobias\'s identical rolls; Deva Aurelius offers poisoned Crucible Charm; discovering the horned beast at Ash Grove (7,6) weeps Celestial tears.
  • Session 3 (Loop 2): Wilderness exploration; learning movement rules (1 hex/hr on foot, 2 hexes/hr by early-day air); following Old Jonas\'s Four Corners prophecy east toward Frostpeak.
ACT II: The Frozen Peak & The Genie Protocol Sessions 4–5 | Milestone: Level 8
  • Session 4 (Loops 3–4): Scouting Dwarvenhold (15,7); meeting Torvald & Brenda; wiping to Rimefang\'s 80ft fly kiting; discovering Harpoon (15,6) and Censer (14,7).
  • Session 5 (Loop 5): Slaying Rimefang! Grounding wings with ballistas/harpoon; Censer negates fear. Unearthing draconic stele with Zephyrus\'s True Name ("Zephyrus-Al-Mubarak"). Unlocks Genie Wish + 1-Time Nimbus Cloud (15m/hex) & Level 8!
ACT III: The Sunken Necropolis & The Alabaster Tablets Sessions 6–7 | Milestone: Level 10
  • Session 6 (Loops 6–7): Invoking Zephyrus at Hex 11,12 for Necrotic Resistance Wish + 1-Time Nimbus Cloud; trading fresh water to Zahir (14,12) for tomb map; gathering Scarab (13,14) & Sunburst Oil (12,13).
  • Session 7 (Loop 8): Entering Necropolis (12,16); smashing Funerary Sarcophagus Seal; reflecting Dread Glare with Mirror-Aegis; double fire dmg destroys Akh-en-Amon. Memorizing Golden Tablets (Somatic Inversion Touch) & Level 10!
ACT IV: Unmasking the Rakshasa, Saving the True Angel & Creating the Loop Sessions 8–9 | Milestone: Level 11
  • Session 8 (Loop 9): Performing the memorized Somatic Inversion Touch at Ash Grove (7,6); halting Druid execution; healing the True Angel; gathering Truesight Monocle (8,6), Circlet (9,7), & Blessed Quiver (7,4).
  • Session 9 (Loop 10): Split-party pathing puzzle (2 Flyers via 8,6 → 7,4; 3 Walkers via 9,7 → 8,7 → 7,6 to heal True Angel) converging at the Mirage Pavilion (10,6) to slay Lord Ravana & memorize his True Name ("Ravana-Zul"). CAUSAL BOOTSTRAP (05:30 → 05:45 → 05:59 AM): Using Ravana's Arcanist's Tachyonic Hourglass with the True Angel, the party jumps back to 05:30 AM, uses the 05:45 AM Silt-Gull bandit raid on the Commodore's Caravel (5,11) as a distraction to steal the Chronocite Bone from Vance's cabin, flies east and crashes into the Clocktower Belfry balcony (8,10), jamming the bone into the gears at 05:59 AM so their 06:00 AM selves retrieve it! → Level 11!
ACT V: The Tempest & The Ocean Chains Sessions 10–11 | Party Level 11
  • Session 10 (Loop 11): Early-day air flight (2 hexes/hr) to West Coast; grabbing Winch Key & Tuning Fork (4,10) and Grounding Rod (4,11); defusing 09:30 Starfire bomb aboard the Beached Caravel (5,11); rescuing the Herald of Otheus and blasting off the Rakshasa's Cursed Barnacles on the pitching ship deck to calm him down so he summons Tempest Lord Otheus for the 17:30 storm!
  • Session 11 (Loop 12): Gaining the trust of Young Kaelen in Room #4 (and under church crypts) to secure the Chronomancy Tuning Fork and learn the Calibration Cipher.
ACT VI: The 12-Hour Route Puzzle & Loop Resolution Sessions 12–13 | Campaign Victory!
  • Session 12 (Loop 13, Part 1): Executing the Split-Party 12-Hour Route Puzzle (06:15 bind Ravana in town → Split: 2 Gryphon Riders fly West within the 2h 06:00–08:00 AM flight window, stopping at Hex 7,10 to retrieve the Burning Book from the marked furrow before saving the Commodore & unchaining Otheus at 5,11 by 10:15 AM, while 3 Walkers secure the Tuning Fork from Young Kaelen in Room #4, march SE to 11,12 Aerie for the Wish of Frozen Heart → 10:30–11:15 AM 1-Time Nimbus Cloud @ 15m/hex reunites all 5 PCs at Ash Grove 7,6 before the default 11:30 AM Soul Detonation to heal the True Angel → afternoon march 2 hexes SW to Spire 6,8 and use the Burning Book to unseal the Spire's solar-adamantine portal).
  • Session 13 (Loop 13, Part 2): 17:30 Category-5 Supercell deflects orbital beam! The Singing Devil (CR 16) battled atop the Spire (6,8) alongside the True Angel. Chanting the Inversion Reversal Rite, restoring true bodies, and safely ending the time loop! TIME LOOP BROKEN!

📜 The Solstice Prophecy: The Four Corners Solution Pipeline

The Roadmap to Defeating the Four Capstone Bosses & Saving Beregost

At 06:00 AM, Old Jonas chants the 8-line prophecy at the municipal well. Each stanza reveals the cardinal direction, the boss, and the permanent counter-mechanic required to resolve the 18:00 PM catastrophe:

🏔️ East: White Wyrm
Slay for Glacial Chart → Djinni Zephyrus → Wish of Frozen Heart.
🏜️ South: Mummy Lord
Sunken Tombs reveal Two Traded Souls & the sacred healing touch.
🌲 North: Striped Fiend
Pierce holy guise → True Name binds web of lies & commands aid.

🌲 FIRST BOSS (Prelude Capstone): The "Horned Fiend" (The True Angel in the Devil's Body)

Hex 7,6 (Weirwood Ash Grove) | CR 10 Monstrous Fiendish Celestial
Target Level: Level 7 (The First Boss Encounter)
AC: 17 (Scorched Infernal Iron-Hide)
HP: 165 (15d10 + 82)
Speed: 40 ft, Fly 60 ft
Prof. Bonus: +4 (DC 16 / Save +10)

The Narrative Hook & The Rakshasa's Delirium Hex: In the prior campaign, freeing the Angel and Devil from the Arcanist's battery swapped their physical bodies. Worse, at dawn Lord Ravana (the Rakshasa, Boss 3 at Hex 10,6) cast a powerful Confusion & Delirium Hex (Crown of Fiendish Delirium) onto the True Angel in the Ash Grove! Blinded by Ravana's hallucinations, the True Angel in the Devil's body is genuinely acting malicious, feral, and violent—attacking the druids and the party on sight with lethal fury! At 07:15 AM, the disguised Rakshasa ("Aurelius") exploits this: "That horned devil in the north woods is rampaging and poisoning the skies! Drive the Crucible Charm into its heart!"

💥 Genuinely Hostile Under Delirium & The 11:30 AM Cataclysmic Explosion:

• Violent & Malicious While Delirious: Because of Ravana's Crown of Fiendish Delirium, the Horned Fiend sees all approaching creatures as Pit Fiend executioners and fights to kill! If slain by the party or executed by Archdruid Faelan's circle at 11:30 AM, its trapped celestial soul ruptures in a Soul Detonation (70 radiant/fire dmg) audible across the entire hex map!

• Literal Meaning of Jonas's Chant: Old Jonas's verse—"Blame not the angel for he is confused, Led astray by the fiendish ruse"—is literally true: the True Angel is magically confused by the Rakshasa's fiendish ruse!

🔍 Forensic Tells & The "Other Way Around" Realization:

• Crown of Fiendish Delirium (DC 14 Insight/Arcana): A shimmering halo of inverted golden mirage-runes crowns his horns, warping his perception and forcing him to attack against his true nature.

• Tragic Dying Words: If slain while delirious, the golden mirage-crown flickers out as he dies; his eyes clear with agonizing grief ("Forgive me... the golden tiger twisted my eyes... I saw only devils...") before the 11:30 AM detonation.

• The Deception Exposed: Recovering the desert tomb tablets in Boss 2 (12,16) and confronting Lord Ravana at the Mirage Stronghold (10,6) reveals that the Rakshasa cast the Delirium Hex to trick the party into murdering their own greatest ally!

🌟 How to Cure Him: Defeat the Rakshasa (Boss 3) First!

• Defeating or Binding Lord Ravana (Hex 10,6): Only after the party defeats the Rakshasa at the Mirage Stronghold (or binds him with his True Name "Ravana-Zul" on later loops) does the Crown of Fiendish Delirium shatter!

• Snapping Out of Delirium: The True Angel immediately snaps out of his confusion, ceases all hostility, halts the 11:30 AM detonation, bestows the Dawnbringer Mantle (+2 AC, 20 Temp HP, Radiant weapon empowerment), and provides full support to the party!

• The Missing Burning Book Clue: Once lucid, the True Angel warns that the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6,8) is sealed by a solar-adamantine ward that can only be opened with the Burning Book dropped in the blazing barleyfields (Hex 7,10)!

👑 CAPSTONE GUARDIAN 1 OF 4 🔍 Boss Portrait

1. Adult White Dragon — Rimefang (Snowy Mountain Peak)

Hex 17,10 above Dwarvenhold | CR 13 Dragon
Target Level: Level 7
AC: 18 (Natural Glacial Armor)
HP: 250 (20d12 + 120)
Speed: 40 ft, Burrow 30, Fly 80
Prof. Bonus: +5 (DC 19 Breath / DC 16 Roar)

The Threat: Nigh impossible without support! Begins airborne (+80 ft), regenerates 25 HP/round via Permafrost Regeneration, stuns/frightens with DC 16 Glacial Roar, and triggers Initiative 20 Lair Actions (Shearing Icicle Barrage 4d8 piercing + Restrained; Flash-Freeze Gale).

🎯 Essential Preparations & Quadrant Counter-Items:

• Rime-Anchor Harpoon (Hex 15,6) & Pike's Halberd: Pins Rimefang to the glacier floor, reducing his 80 ft fly speed to 0 ft and granting melee attackers Advantage on their first round of strikes!

• Drake-Bane Censer (Hex 14,7 — Dwarven Pass-Phrase "Khazad-Mor"): Lighting this dwarven incense burner creates a 30-ft warm thermal aura that halves Cold damage, completely suppresses Rimefang's 25 HP/round Permafrost Regeneration, and prevents his Flash-Freeze Gale Lair Action!

• 6 Glacial Cover Pillars (P1–P6 in the 60×60 ft Vault): Standing behind any of the 6 pillars in Rimefang's expanded 60×60 ft Frost Vault grants Three-Quarters Cover (+5 AC/Dex saves) or Total Cover against his 60-ft Cold Breath cone!

🎁 Victory Payoff (Milestone: Level 8 — Prophecy Stanza 2):

"Slay the white wyrm for his chart, To claim a wish of frozen heart."
Slaying Rimefang unseals the Frozen Wind-Stele of Zephyrus (T14–U15) and yields his Glacial Treasure Chart, pinpointing the corporeal Brass Lamp of Zephyrus the Cloud-Lord (Djinni) at the Aerie of the Four Winds (11, 12) and revealing his True Name ("Zephyrus-Al-Mubarak") and the Auran Wind-Prayer (note: Zephyrus himself is inside his Brass Lamp at Hex 11,12, not physically in this cave!). On future loops, speaking his memorized True Name at (11, 12) compels Zephyrus by elemental law (without needing to re-slay Rimefang) to grant 1 Elemental Wish (e.g., Wish of Frozen Heart for 175°F afternoon heat immunity) AND a Nimbus Cloud capable of a ONE-TIME traversal at 15 minutes per hex in one move only!

Tail Swipe. Trigger: A creature within 10 ft hits the dragon with a melee attack. Response: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.
Legendary Actions (3/Round):
Tail Attack (Costs 1 Action). Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, creatures within 10 ft. Failure: 13 (2d6 + 6) Bludgeoning damage and knocked Prone. The dragon flies up to half its fly speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
🧭 Discovery & Pipeline Progression:

• How Discovered: Old Jonas's Solstice Prophecy ("First east to the ice... Slay the white wyrm for his chart, to claim a wish of frozen heart") and Snirk the Goblin's sighting point the party east to Rimefang's glacier.

• What Victory Unlocks: Yields the Glacial Chart & Djinni True Name ("Zephyrus-Al-Mubarak"). Invoking Zephyrus at (11, 12) grants 1 Wish + 1 One-Time Nimbus Cloud move (15m/hex in one move only) and reveals the Sunken Necropolis in the South Desert (Boss 2 Mummy Lord)!

2. Mummy Lord — Akh-en-Amon (Desert Sand Tomb)

South Desert Sunken Crypt (Hex 12,16 via 14,12) | CR 15 Undead (in Lair)
Target Level: Level 8 to 9
AC: 18 (Gilded Bronzewood & Lapis Wrappings)
HP: 240 (24d8 + 132) + 40 Temp HP Ward
Speed: 25 ft
Prof. Bonus: +5 (DC 17 / Save +9)

The Threat: Protected by a 40 Temp HP Solar-Desiccated Ward (granting immunity to critical hits and 15 HP/round necrotic siphon while active) and flanked by 2x Mummy Sentinels (CR 3, 58 HP each)! Unleashes DC 17 Dreadful Glare (Frightened + Paralyzed), Mummy Rot (HP max drain, no healing), and 6d10 Insect Plague.

🎯 Essential Preparations & Quadrant Counter-Items:

• Phial of Sunburst Oil (Hex 12,13 — Guarded by Desert Basilisk): Thrown splash weapon instantly shatters Akh-en-Amon's 40 Temp HP Solar-Desiccated Ward, ignites him for 4d6 Radiant damage at the start of each of his turns, and suppresses his Blinding Dust & Sandstorm Whirlwind for 3 rounds!

• Golden Mirror-Aegis (Hex 11,12 — Auran Wind-Seal): +2 Shield; Reaction reflects Dreadful Glare and Rotting Fist curses back onto Akh-en-Amon, shattering his Solar-Desiccated Ward!

• Scarab of Solar Resurgence (Hex 13,14 — Bound Air Elemental / Auran Wind-Prayer): Grants Necrotic & HP-max drain immunity, and unleashes a 1/battle 30-ft Solar Flare that destroys his 2 Mummy Sentinels and suppresses his Lair Actions!

• Funerary Sarcophagus Seal (Canopic Heart) & Memorized Tablets: Destroying the Funerary Sarcophagus Seal (AC 17, 50 HP) prevents his rejuvenation and unseals the Golden Alabaster Tablets!

🎁 Victory Payoff (Milestone: Level 10 — Prophecy Stanza 3):

"South: sunken tombs of sand reveal Two traded souls a touch must heal."
Uncovers the Inversion Tablets of the Arcanist in the Sunken Necropolis, proving the Two Traded Souls: the singing entity on the belfry is the Archdevil, while the horned beast in the woods is the True Angel. By memorizing the sacred Somatic Inversion Touch, the party can heal the True Angel on future loops without ever returning to the desert tomb!

3. The Rakshasa — Lord Ravana / "Aurelius the Radiant" (Twisted Forest)

North Gate Shrine (Hex 8,9) & The Mirage Pavilion (Hex 10,6) | CR 13 Fiend
Target Level: Level 10
AC: 18 (Natural Armor & Silk Ward)
HP: 210 (20d8 + 120)
Speed: 40 ft
Prof. Bonus: +5 (DC 18 / Save +10)

The Threat: Guarded by the Four Grand Illusions of the Mirage Pavilion—(1) Room 1's Phantom Dawn Reset (tricking players into thinking the 06:00 AM loop restarted), (2) Room 2's Innocent Freestanding Palace Mirrors (where walking directly in front of a mirror at F14–F16 or J11–J13 spawns an avoidable CR 13 Evil Twin!), (3) Room 3's False Boss Victory Ruse (a CR 7 Mirage Simulacrum that baits out high-level spell slots before melting into sand), and (4) Room 4's True Sanctum where the Real Ravana uses Telepathic Table-Talk Mind Reading ("Table Talk = Advantage!"), is immune to spells of 6th level and lower & nonmagical weapons, is protected by 3 Obsidian Mirror-Shades (shatters a mirror on 30+ single-hit damage to halve damage, teleport 30 ft, and spawn a decoy!), and blasts minds with DC 18 Psychic Mind-Lash (4d8 psychic + Confused). Worse, Ravana is the Architect of the Fiendish Delirium—maintaining the Confusion/Delirium Hex that makes the True Angel at the Ash Grove (Hex 7,6) violently attack everyone in sight!

🎯 Essential Preparations & Quadrant Counter-Items:

• Monocle of Piercing Truth (Hex 8,6 — Guarded by Basilisk): Grants Truesight 60 ft against illusions, pierces the Room 1–3 Mirage Pavilion illusions, reveals the real Ravana among his 3 Obsidian Mirror-Shades, and exposes the mirror tethers so the party can shatter them directly!

• Circlet of Mind Sanctity (Hex 9,7 — Guarded by Displacer Beast): Grants immunity to Charmed, Frightened, and Confused conditions, halves Psychic damage from Ravana's Psychic Mind-Lash, blocks Dominate Person, and shields the wearer's thoughts from Ravana's Room 4 Telepathic Table-Talk Mind Reading!

• Quiver of the Just Stalker (Hex 7,4) & Blessed Cold-Iron Weapons (Hex 15,7): Bypass his immunities, deal double Piercing damage from good characters + 2d8 Radiant damage, and halt his fiendish regeneration!

🎭 The Roadside Interception & Why the True Angel Attacks You (Hex 8, 9 North Road)

At Hex (8, 9) (North Gate Shrine / Coast Way Fork), the party is intercepted by Lord Ravana disguised as the golden arch-mage "Aurelius the Radiant". Before dawn, Ravana cast a powerful Confusion / Delirium Hex (Crown of Fiendish Delirium) onto the True Angel trapped in the Horned Fiend's body at the Ash Grove (Hex 7,6)—making the True Angel act genuinely malicious and violently attack the druids and the party on sight!

"Travelers! I saw the horror in your eyes at dawn—you remember the end of yesterday, don't you? You saw the blinding cataclysm at the Western Sea Cliffs... That celestial being atop the coastal spire is the Solar Seraph, but its mind is confused, shattered by grief. Worse, its madness is projected by a vicious, rampaging horned devil lurking in the Ash Grove to the north (Hex 7, 6)! Look how it slaughters the druids! Hunt down and slay that horned devil in the ash grove!"

• Why the Trap Works So Well: When the party arrives at the Ash Grove (Hex 7,6), the Horned Fiend really does attack them with lethal malice! They have no idea that he is the True Angel suffering under Ravana's Delirium Hex—making Old Jonas's line ("Blame not the angel for he is confused, led astray by the fiendish ruse") literally true!
• How Defeating Boss 3 Frees the True Angel: Only after defeating Lord Ravana at the Mirage Stronghold (Hex 10,6) (or binding him with his True Name "Ravana-Zul") does the Delirium Hex shatter—causing the True Angel at (7,6) to snap out of his confusion and provide full Celestial support to the party!

🧠 Meta-Game Illusion & Deception Mechanics:
Includes Secret Wis Save Token Swaps, the Phantom Dawn Reset script, and Open Table-Talk Exploitation!
🎁 Victory Payoff — Compelled Confession of True Name & Secrets (Milestone: Level 11 — Prophecy Stanza 4):

"North: pierce the striped fiend’s holy guise, His true name binds his web of lies."
When the party defeats Lord Ravana in the Mirage Pavilion (Hex 10,6), ancient infernal law compels him to speak his True Name ("Ravana-Zul") and confess his master secrets:
1. The True Angel Cured: His defeat shatters the Crown of Fiendish Delirium on the True Angel at Hex (7,6), who immediately snaps out of his confusion and allies with the party!
2. The Secret of the Herald's Barnacles (Boss 4): Ravana confesses that he grafted Cursed Mind-Barnacles onto the Herald of Otheus aboard the Beached Caravel (Hex 5,11) to drive him crazy—revealing that the party must blast off all of the barnacles during the ship-deck fight to calm the Herald down!
3. Instant Binding on Future Loops: Speaking his True Name "Ravana-Zul" on subsequent loops binds him without a fight!

4. Storm Giant — Tempest Lord Otheus & The Huge Herald of Otheus (Beached Caravel Ship-Deck Duel)

West Coast Wreck of "The Sea Maiden" (Hex 5,11) | CR 13 Ship-Deck Fight (Huge Herald Outside Ship)
Target Level: Level 11 Capstone
AC: 18 (Barnacles on Him: AC 16 / 13)
HP: 230 (4 Barnacles × 55 HP on Him)
Size / Position: Huge (15×15 ft) Outside Ship
Prof. Bonus: +5 (DC 17 / Save +13)

The Encounter — The 3-Step Harpoon-Pull Loop on the Ship Deck: When the party boards the Beached Caravel (Hex 5,11), disarms the 09:30 AM Starfire powder fuse in the lower hold, and ascends to the top of the open wooden main deck, they confront Valen Storm-Caller, the Huge 25-foot-tall Herald of Otheus!
• 1. Fight to the Deck Harpoons & Aim (Melee Objective!): By default, the Huge Herald stands 35 feet outside the ship in the deep surf (Cols R–T, out of melee reach) while Sahuagin boarders guard the ship's two Heavy Whaling Harpoon-Launchers (HP1 at N4 & HP2 at N8). Melee characters must fight through the Sahuagin on the pitching deck, reach a Harpoon-Launcher, aim it, and shoot a chained harpoon into the Herald (Action: Attack +PB + STR/DEX vs. AC 15 or DC 14 Athletics; Bonus Action w/ Advantage if the Abyssal Winch Key is slotted in Capstan J6!).
• 2. Pulled Into the Ship — Target the 4 Barnacles on the Herald!: Hitting with a harpoon winches the Huge Herald 30 feet inward and pins him right against the ship's starboard railing (Cols O–Q)! For 1 round, melee and ranged characters can hack directly at the 4 glowing purple-black Cursed Mind-Barnacle Clusters on the Herald himself (AC 16, or AC 13 with the Tuning Fork; 55 HP each) with Advantage on melee attacks!
• 3. Chain Snaps & He Retreats — Repeat!: Each harpoon only holds him briefly: after 1 round (or as soon as 1 of his 4 Barnacle Clusters shatters), the Herald snaps the harpoon cable and retreats 35 feet back out into the surf, requiring the party to fight to a Harpoon-Launcher, aim, and pull him back in! Destroying all 4 barnacles calms him down so he blows the Abyssal Storm-Conch to summon Tempest Lord Otheus!

🎯 Essential Preparations & Quadrant Counter-Items to Supercharge the Harpoons & Target the Barnacles:

• Abyssal Winch Key & Brass Tidal Tuning Fork (Hex 4,10 — Raider Sea Caves): Slotting the Winch Key into the deck capstan (J6) stabilizes the 15-degree listing ship deck (removing Difficult Terrain) AND powers the mechanized harpoon winches—allowing the party to aim, shoot, and reel in the Deck Harpoons as a Bonus Action with Advantage! Meanwhile, the Tuning Fork's F-sharp resonance loosens the 4 Cursed Barnacle Clusters on the Herald's body (lowering their AC from 16 to 13)!

• Grounding Rod of the Deep Trench (Hex 4,11 — Guarded by Sahuagin Baron): Planted into the wooden deck at the mainmast (M6), it absorbs all Storm-Conducting Wet Plank chain-lightning across the ship and channels a 10d8 Lightning surge straight down the iron harpoon cable into the Huge Herald—instantly blasting one of the Cursed Barnacle Clusters off his chest!

🎁 Victory Payoff (Milestone: Level 11 — Prophecy Stanza 5):

"West: break the deep-sea giant’s chain, To drag the singing wings to rain."
Destroying all 4 Cursed Mind-Barnacle Clusters on the Huge Herald himself calms him down and restores his sanity! Grateful, he blows his Abyssal Storm-Conch from the surf beside the ship, summoning the colossal Tempest Lord Otheus from the deep ocean trench. At 17:30 PM, Otheus unleashes a Category-5 Supercell Storm-Cloud over Beregost and the Western Spire—dragging the singing wings to rain and deflecting 85% of the 17:59 PM solar beam!

5. TRUE FINAL BOSS: The Singing Devil in the Angel's Body (Spire of the False Angel)

Hex 6,8 (Spire of the False Angel) & Hex 8,10 (Clocktower Belfry) | CR 16 Fiend/Celestial Hybrid (Level 11 Finale)
Target Level: Level 11 (Campaign Climax)
AC: 19 (Natural Armor & Aegis)
HP: 245 (22d10 + 110)
Speed: 30 ft, Fly 90 ft (Hover)
Prof. Bonus: +5 (DC 19 / Save +11)

The Threat & True Identity: The ancient Archdevil trapped in the radiant, feathered body of the True Angel. At 17:30 PM (5:30 PM), six chimes ring and the Singing Devil begins singing the sun down atop the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8), its haunting celestial choir reverberating across the Western Sea Cliffs. (On Day 1 / Loop 0, the party is deep in Beregost; looking west toward the Sea of Swords, they witness the horrific spectacle of the angel pulling the setting sun down from afar before the thermal wave wipes the land).

👑 Four Corners Campaign Climax (Prophecy Stanzas 1 & 6):

"With six chimes the belfry wakes, The choir sings, the mountain shakes.
First east to the ice, then south to the sand, Find the path to stop the devil's hand.
Blame not the angel for he is confused, Led astray by the fiendish ruse.
Four corners mend the falling sun, Or dawn resets what dusk begun."
At 17:30 PM, six chimes ring across the valley and the Singing Devil ascends the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8) on the Western Sea Cliffs, its haunting celestial choir resonating through the Beregost Clocktower Belfry (Hex 8, 10) to pull the setting sun down onto the coastal promontory with cosmic magic. By combining all Four Corners—the Wish of Frozen Heart to endure the heat, the Storm Giant's tempest to drag its singing wings to rain, the bound Rakshasa to dispel illusions, and the sacred healing touch from the sunken tombs to restore the True Angel—the party storms the Spire, restores the True Angel, and mends the falling sun, permanently breaking the 12-hour time loop!

🎯 Essential Preparations & Tactical Counters:

• The True Angel (Allied Striker): Rescued and cleansed from Ash Grove (Hex 7,6), the True Angel (in the horned fiend's body) flies alongside the party to the Western Spire, matching the Devil's flight speed and grappling it away from the solar altar.

• Grounded Lockdown: Pike uses the Long Arm of the Law halberd to hook and ground the Devil's wings, while Burk pins it against the ancient stone parapet.

• Supercell Storm Deflection: Tempest Lord Otheus (unchained at Hex 5,11) deflects 85% of the 17:59 orbital solar beam with a Category-5 thunderstorm over the Western Spire (only 3 hexes away along the coast), preventing automatic party annihilation.

⚡ Breaking the Loop Permanently:

1. Sunder the Singing Devil's celestial aegis using Gwen's radiant-fire magic and blessed weapons.

2. The True Angel chants the Inversion Reversal Rite from the Golden Alabaster Tablets, swapping their souls back into their true divine and fiendish bodies!

3. Strike the master bronze bell with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork and physically shatter the Chronocite Bone / Solar Prism before 18:00 PM. Time advances to 18:01 PM. The time loop permanently breaks!

🧩 The Endgame "Golden Loop" 12-Hour Split-Party Route Puzzle (06:00 AM – 17:30 PM):

Because only memories and milestone level-ups persist across resets, the Level 11 party wakes at 06:00 AM with zero carried-over items or active pacts. Under calibrated movement rules—1 hex/hr (60m/hex) on foot, 2 hexes/hr (30m/hex) for 2 hours (06:00–08:00 AM) on Pike's Bone-Whistle Gryphon (carries 2 players while 3 walk), and Djinni Zephyrus's ONE-TIME Nimbus Cloud traversal at 15 min/hex in one continuous move only—the party solves the final day by splitting into three synchronized sub-teams that converge at the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6,8):

• 06:00–14:00 PM (West Gryphon Team — Pike & Burk: 2h Dawn Air @ 30m/hex until 08:00 AM, then On Foot @ 60m/hex): Depart at 06:00 AM sharp on Gryphon Zephyr. Fly 1 hex West to Blazing Farmland (Hex 7,10) (06:00–06:30 AM) to snatch the Burning Book from the northern stone culvert furrow spotted at 05:45 AM, then fly 3 hexes West to Raider Sea Caves (Hex 4,10) by 08:00 AM sharp (4 hexes total flown as the 2h dawn flight window closes). Use memorized leverage on Prophet Joshua ("The hooded deceiver lied to you!") to claim the Abyssal Winch Crank-Key & Brass Tidal Tuning Fork without combat, walk 1 hex South to Sunken Reef (4,11) (08:00–09:00 AM) for the Grounding Rod, walk 1 hex East to Beached Caravel (5,11) (09:00–10:00 AM) to stop the Starfire bomb, harpoon-pull the Huge Herald of Otheus into the ship rail to smash his 4 Cursed Barnacle Clusters and summon Tempest Lord Otheus (10:00–11:00 AM), then walk 3 hexes North (5,11 → 5,10 → 6,9 → 6,8) to arrive at the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6,8) at 14:00 PM and unseal its solar-adamantine gates with the Burning Book!
• 06:00–06:15 AM (Town Team — Phillipa, Gwen & Grog in Beregost Hub, Hex 8,10): Ambush Lord Ravana in Cobbler's Lane before he departs for (8,9) and bind him with his memorized True Name ("Ravana-Zul") — solving Boss 3 in 15 minutes with 0 hexes traveled! He surrenders his Blessed Quiver & Monocle, and is bound to report to Spire (6,8) at 17:30 PM. Meanwhile, give the secret knock at Room #4 of Feldepost's Inn to collect the Chronomancy Tuning Fork directly from Young Kaelen, and brief Captain Rebecca Thorne and Sister Althea to prepare the town defenses.
• 06:15–13:30 PM (North Envoy — Phillipa On Foot, 5h to Ash Grove + 2h w/ Staff): Walk North (8,10 → 8,9 → 8,8 → 8,7 → 7,6, 3h road/verge + 2h heavy forest) to reach Ash Grove (Hex 7,6) at 11:15 AM—15 minutes before Archdruid Faelan's default 11:30 AM execution! Perform the memorized Somatic Inversion Touch (from Boss 2's Tablets) to halt the ritual, receive Faelan's Weirwood Staff, heal the True Angel, and walk 2 hexes SW (7,6 → 7,7 → 6,8) to the Spire (Hex 6,8) by 13:30 PM!
• 06:15–12:30 PM (Southeast Team — Gwen & Grog On Foot @ 60m/hex + 1-Time Genie Nimbus Cloud @ 15m/hex): Walk 4 hexes SE (8,10 → 9,10 → 10,10 → 11,11 → 11,12) to Aerie of the Four Winds (Hex 11,12) (06:15–10:15 AM). Speak Djinni Zephyrus's memorized True Name ("Zephyrus-Al-Mubarak") to activate the Wish of Frozen Heart (party-wide afternoon heat immunity) and board his One-Time Nimbus Cloud (15m/hex in ONE continuous move) right at (11,12) to streak 8 hexes NW (2.0h, 10:30 AM–12:30 PM) directly across the valley to the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6,8)!
• 17:30–17:59 PM (Full United Level 11 Party at Spire, Hex 6,8 & Sympathetic Belfry Rift, Hex 8,10): Inside the unsealed Spire parapet, Otheus's Category-5 Supercell Hurricane deflects 85% of the solar beam, bound Ravana shatters the mirror wards, and the True Angel grapples The Singing Devil (CR 16). Defeat the Devil, reverse the soul-swap, and strike the sympathetic resonance rift with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork to shatter the Chronocite Bone before 18:00 PM!

🕸️ Capstone Boss Execution DAGs (Directed Acyclic Graphs)

High-Lethality Single-Loop Planning

In a 12-hour time loop where death has no persistent penalty, capstone bosses (CR 13–15) are tuned to extreme, lethal lethality. Random wilderness combat will bleed the party's spell slots, rages, and hit dice. To defeat a boss, players must discover required relics across previous loops, map an optimized single-loop route that bypasses resource-draining hexes, collect 2–3 specific counter-items, and execute a razor-thin tactical duel.

🎭 The Tiger-Headed Mastermind: "Aurelius the Radiant" (Lord Ravana)

The Great Deceiver • Appears 07:00 – 07:30 AM

Beneath the resplendent golden Deva illusion hides a lethal Tiger-Headed Rakshasa with backwards hands, silk robes, and insidious enchantment magic.

🦊 The "Confused Angel & Powerful Devil" Cover Story (Roadside Interception on Loop 1+):

• Witnessing the West Coast Cataclysm: On Loop 0 at 17:59 PM, the party watches the sun being pulled down onto the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8) on the distant Western Sea Cliffs. Naturally, at dawn of Loop 1, they rush west along the Coast Way toward the Spire.

• The Roadside Interception (Hex 8, 9): Aurelius the Radiant intercepts them outside the North Gate, feigning sympathy: "You remember yesterday's ending... You saw the blinding flare at the Western Spire! But you march toward your deaths. The being on the Spire is the Solar Seraph, but its mind is confused, broken by grief. Worse, its madness is projected by a powerful devil in the Ash Grove to the north (Hex 7, 6)! You must hunt down that powerful devil and drive the Crucible Charm into its heart to quiet the skies!"

• Weaponizing Old Jonas's Rhyme: Aurelius quotes the old man's exact prophecy: "First east to the ice, then south to the sand, find the path to stop the devil's hand. Blame not the angel for he is confused, led astray by the fiendish ruse." He convinces the party that the being on the Spire is merely "confused" and the beast in the woods is the "fiendish ruse / powerful devil."

• The Horrific Trap: By framing the True Angel (trapped in the horned fiend's body) as the "powerful devil", the Rakshasa manipulates the party into assassinating their own true ally, permanently sealing the Singing Devil's victory!

• The Crucible Charm Trap: Driving the charm into the True Angel triggers an instant soul-binding curse that accelerates the solar cataclysm to noon!

• The "Other Way Around" Epiphany: When the party recovers the Inversion Swap tablets from Boss 2's desert crypt and unmasks the Rakshasa's feline face, they realize: The tiger guy has been tricking us the whole time—it's the exact other way around!
