# 14.4.5 The Mind & Motives of Prophet Joshua: Delusion, Deception & The False Flood

Why is Prophet Joshua risking his life to rob the Sea Maiden, rally vicious coastal cutthroats, and strike the brass tuning fork in the tidal caverns? Joshua is not a run-of-the-mill bandit; he is a tragic, fanatic figure driven by four intersecting motives:

# 1. The Apocalyptic Vision (The "Cleansing Flood")

  • A True Vision with a False Interpretation: Three nights before the solstice, Joshua—an apostate coastal hermit and self-proclaimed "Prophet of the Tides"—began experiencing vivid, terrifying prophetic nightmares of the 18:00 PM Solar Detonation. He saw the sun plunging into the Beregost belfry and incinerating the valley into weeping slag.
  • The Fanatic's Delusion: In Joshua's twisted mind, this solar fire is divine punishment for the land-dwellers' sins. He believes the only salvation lies in the deep, cold embrace of the Sea of Swords:
"The fiery eye shall burn the stone to ash, but the sea cannot burn! We must bring the water inland! We must summon the Great Deluge to drown the false sun before dusk!"
  • By striking the stolen tuning fork against the resonant cavern walls, Joshua believes he is chanting the opening verses of a holy deluge that will submerge the coast and wash over Beregost, "baptizing" the valley in cooling salt water to protect it from the fire.

# 2. The Manipulation of Prophet Joshua (The Apocalyptic Delusion)

  • The Deceiver's Flattery: The coastal raiders and conspirators needed the Sea Maiden permanently destroyed so the captive Herald of Otheus could never be freed and calmed to summon Tempest Lord Otheus (Boss 4).
  • The Lie: A hooded emissary (the disguised Rakshasa Lord Ravana) approached Joshua in the Coastal Fishing Port three days ago. Playing directly to Joshua's religious mania, the cloaked figure whispered that the warship Sea Maiden was an "abomination of iron" that had imprisoned a sacred sea-herald. The hooded emissary claimed:
"Scuttle the warship with our alchemical Starfire powder, and the great sea-god shall break free to drown the skies in rain! Strike the brass chime, and the deeps will obey!"
  • The Bribe: To sweeten the deal for Bloodfin's cutthroats, the conspirators delivered 12 barrels of volatile Starfire powder and a forged Town Hall promissory chit for 500 gold pieces.
  • The Tragic Irony: Joshua genuinely believes detonating the powder hold at 09:45 AM will "liberate the ocean." In reality, a 100d6 Starfire blast kills the Herald of Otheus, destroys the Storm-Conch, and eliminates the only way to summon the elemental titan capable of deflecting the solar beam! Joshua is fanatically working to cause the very apocalypse he fears.

# 3. Obsession with the Brass Tidal Tuning Fork ("The Sea Mother's Chime")

  • When Joshua spied the brass tuning fork inside the caravel's chartroom, he recognized its ancient planar resonance. Forged centuries ago to harmonize the boundary between the Elemental Plane of Water and the Material Plane, the fork vibrates naturally to the pitch of F-sharp (the exact frequency that loosens the Cursed Mind-Barnacles on the Herald of Otheus!).
  • Joshua convinced himself that the fork is the sacred scepter of the deeps. By striking it in the Raider Sea Caves (Hex 4, 10) at 06:45 AM, he attempts to harmonize with the ocean currents and summon aquatic allies (sahuagin and giant octopuses).
  • The Reality: The fork's acoustic shockwave vibrates the shallow continental shelf and triggers an unnatural, boiling Storm Surge (120°F–150°F) that will flood and drown Joshua's own cave hideout by 10:30 AM!

# 4. The Alliance with Captain Bloodfin & The Silt-Gull Bandits

  • To the ruthless wrecker Captain "Shark-Tooth" Bloodfin, Joshua's visions are a convenient blessing. Bloodfin cares nothing for holy floods; he sees:
  • An opportunity to plunder a 60-gun naval war caravel loaded with brass cannons and navigational charts.
  • The hooded deceiver's 500 gp forged Town Hall bounty, which promises immense wealth for his crew.
  • The chance to dominate the coastline once Beregost is crippled by the solstice anomaly.

# Tactical Roleplay & Social Intervention (Resolving Joshua)

  • Parley / Insight Check (DC 13 Wisdom [Insight]): A character listening to Joshua's chanting realizes he is terrified of the 18:00 PM sunset fire and genuinely believes he is saving the world through flooding.
  • The Shattering Truth (DC 14 Charisma [Persuasion] or Intelligence [Religion]):
  • If the party exposes the false prophecy or explains the true nature of the planar battery:
"The deceivers lied to you! The titan chained below isn't a demon of fire—he is Tempest Lord Otheus, a Storm Giant who summons cold rain! Your Starfire bomb won't liberate him; it will murder him and leave the sun to incinerate us all!"
  • Joshua breaks down in horror, his religious certainty collapsing. He hands over the Abyssal Winch Crank-Key and the Brass Tidal Tuning Fork, shouting:
"They lied to me! The deceivers wanted the storm silenced! Take the key to the caravel—stop Bloodfin's fuse before the powder burns!"
  • If Attacked (Combat / CR 3): Joshua fights fanatically with his Tidal Chime sonic blasts (2d8 thunder, 15-ft cone), willing to die as a martyr before the rising tides.
  • Default Fate: If the party does not intervene, Joshua boards the caravel at 09:30 AM with Bloodfin and is vaporized in his own 09:45 AM Starfire explosion.

# 14.5 🏰 The Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8) & Beregost Clocktower Belfry (Hex 8, 10)

  • Theme: Sympathetic Coastal Solar Spire & Vertical Clockwork Loop Terminal
  • Recommended Level: Level 11 (True Finale)
  • Boss Threat: The Singing Devil (True Final Boss) (CR 16 (Level 11 Finale))
  • Overview: The finale spans two sympathetically linked towers: the soaring 150-foot Beregost Clocktower Belfry (Hex 8, 10)—ground zero of the temporal loop where the Chronocite Bone wedges the escapement gear at 05:59 AM—and the ancient Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8) perched atop the Western Sea Cliffs, where the Singing Devil (wearing the Angel's radiant body) channels the solar apocalypse over the Sea of Swords. At 17:30 PM, when Tempest Lord Otheus (Hex 5, 11) unleashes his Category-5 Hurricane over the western cliffs, the storm suppresses 85% of the solar beam, allowing the party and the True Angel to confront the Singing Devil atop the Spire (Hex 6, 8), reverse the soul swap, and then strike the Clocktower Bell (Hex 8, 10) with Kaelen's Chronomancy Tuning Fork to sunder the Chronocite Bone before 18:00 PM!

# Strategic Relics & Campaign Breakthroughs

  • The Great Escapement Gear (Hex 8, 10): Giant 20-foot bronze cogwheel in the Beregost Clocktower that governs the flow of local time; inserting the bone or tuning fork alters timeline continuity.
  • The Solstice Bronze Bell (Hex 8, 10): Master bell whose strike at 06:00 AM echoes across all 380 hexes; can be rung with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork to shatter the loop.
  • The Coastal Solar Parapet & Prism (Hex 6, 8): The high open-air altar on the Western Sea Cliffs where the Singing Devil sings down the sun and battles the party during the 17:30 PM hurricane.
  • ⭐ The Burning Book (Hex 7, 10 Key): A living solar-angelic grimoire dropped by the party in the western barleyfields on their initial approach to Beregost, which ignited the wildfire. Identified at 05:45 AM as a tiny fire from above and retrieved from the marked furrow; required to disengage the searing solar-adamantine portal wards and open the Spire of the Angel!

# Solstice Clockwork Timeline Hazards

  • 05:59 – 06:00 AM: Loop Ground Zero (Hex 8, 10). The clock is jammed at 05:59 AM. Removing the bone causes a 4d10 thunder bell strike and initiates the loop.
  • 06:00 – 12:00 PM: Normal Operation (Hex 8, 10) & Violet Dawn Glare (Hex 6, 8). Clockwork ticks with deafening precision while the False Angel begins its solar hymn on the sea cliffs.
  • 12:00 – 17:30 PM: Overheating Cogwheels & Solar Convergence. Escapement gears expand and glow red-hot (2d8 fire damage), while the Spire at Hex (6, 8) becomes an unapproachable 250°F furnace until Otheus's 17:30 PM hurricane arrives.
  • 18:00 PM: 💥 TOTAL SOLAR DETONATION! If unstopped, the orbital solar incinerator converges between the Spire (6, 8) and the Clocktower Belfry (8, 10), unleashing a 100d10 radiant wipeout across the valley.

# Room-by-Room Layout

  1. Room 1: Bellringer's Workshop & Ground Vestry (Hex 8, 10)
  • Description: Workbenches littered with brass filings, magnifying loupes, calipers, and gear blueprints. Spare escapement wheels hang from oak beams.
  • Creatures: 2x Clockwork Watch Sentinels
  • Hazard/Trap: Greased Floor Traps: Pressure plates trigger oil slicks on the entrance stairs (DC 13 Dex save or fall prone).
  • Secrets/Loot: Bram's Journal: Notes that the bone found in the gears at 05:59 AM was carved with celestial angelic runes—placed from the future!
  1. Room 2: Weight Shaft & Pendulum Chasm (Hex 8, 10)
  • Description: A 90-foot vertical shaft through which two massive 4-ton lead counterweights rise and fall beside a swinging 30-foot brass pendulum.
  • Creatures: 1x Greater Air Elemental
  • Hazard/Trap: Swinging Pendulum: Climbing the iron ladder requires DC 14 Dex save every 30 feet to avoid being clipped by the pendulum (4d8 bludgeoning).
  • Secrets/Loot: Maintenance Niche: A small hatch at the 45-foot mark contains 3 Potions of Flying and a Feather Fall token.
  1. Room 3: The Smashed Western Balcony & Escapement Gear Train (Hex 8, 10 — Early Bootstrap Clue #1)
  • Description: A dizzying labyrinth of interlocking bronze, iron, and silver gears 15 feet in diameter, churning with rhythmic CLACK-CLACK-CLACK cadence beneath the 10-ton Solstice Bronze Bell. The western stone balcony and arched balustrade of the belfry are freshly smashed inward into a heap of broken masonry and rubble, with scorched stone and heavy wing-gouges—where something hurtling out of the western sky crashed straight into the tower at 05:59 AM and jammed the Chronocite Bone into the escapement gear!
  • Creatures: 3x Arcane Clockwork Spiders
  • Hazard/Trap: Grinding Teeth: Getting caught between interlocking gears deals 6d10 crushing damage (DC 16 Dex check to avoid).
  • Secrets/Loot: ⭐ The Escapement Slot & Resonance Portal: The exact gear tooth where the party pulled the bone at 06:00 AM on Loop 0—and where their future selves jammed it at 05:59 AM after crashing through the balcony! Striking the bell with the Chronomancy Tuning Fork opens a direct sympathetic translocation rift to the Spire of the False Angel (Hex 6, 8)—and after the Devil falls, sundering the Chronocite Bone here permanently breaks the time loop!
  1. Room 4: The Spire of the False Angel Parapet (Hex 6, 8 — 17:30 PM Climax Arena)
  • Description: A jagged, wind-lashed Gothic spire jutting above the crashing waves of the Sea of Swords. At 17:30 PM, Otheus's Category-5 Hurricane clashes against the blinding solar plasma above the parapet as the Singing Devil descends in wrath!
  • Creatures: 1x The Singing Devil (True Final Boss, CR 16)
  • Hazard/Trap: 18:00 Orbital Beam Convergence: Every round after 17:50 PM, radiant energy builds, dealing 2d10 radiant damage at start of turn (reduced by 85% while Otheus's hurricane holds).
  • Secrets/Loot: ⭐ Reversing the Soul Swap & Shattering the Loop: Defeating the Singing Devil while the True Angel chants the Inversion Words from the Golden Alabaster Tablets restores both beings to their true forms; the restored True Angel and party then shatter the Chronocite core in the Clocktower Belfry (Hex 8, 10), ending the loop before 18:00 PM!

# 14.6 🌟 Ash Grove & The Elder Weirwood (Hex 7, 6)

  • Theme: Sacred Blood-Red Weirwood Grove & Druidic Execution Ring
  • Recommended Level: Level 7 (Prelude Boss / Boss 0)
  • Boss Threat: Horned Fiend (The True Angel) & Druid Circle (CR 10 (Prelude Duel))
  • Overview: Deep in the northern briarwood forest stands Ash Grove, a clearing centered around an ancient weeping weirwood tree with bleeding red sap. At 06:00 AM, the True Angel (trapped in the Horned Fiend's body) crash-lands here after escaping the arcanist's battery. Archdruid Faelan and his circle believe it is an archdevil corrupting the forest. Every loop by default, the druids hunt down and encircle the creature (inviting the party to join if present, or executing it themselves if the party is elsewhere). At 11:30 AM, their execution—or the party's attack with Aurelius's Crucible Charm—triggers a catastrophic soul detonation (70 radiant/fire damage across 300 feet), wiping out the grove!

# Strategic Relics & Campaign Breakthroughs

  • Celestial Tears of the Horned Fiend: Pure radiant tears wept by the fiend; smells of frankincense and morning ozone, hinting at a deeper mystery, and acts as a Potion of Supreme Healing.
  • Elder Weirwood Sap: Bleeding crimson resin that grants immunity to fire damage for 2 hours.
  • Archdruid Faelan's Oak Staff: Staff of the Woodlands; allows speaking with plants and commanding the briar wall to open.

# Solstice Clockwork Timeline Hazards

  • 06:00 AM: Fiend Crash-Landing. A smoking crater opens in the clearing as the Horned Fiend crash-lands, bleeding white-silver ozone ichor.
  • 08:30 – 10:30 AM: Druidic Encirclement. Archdruid Faelan's circle surrounds the clearing, erecting a 20-foot wall of razor thorns.
  • 10:30 – 11:30 AM: The Binding Chant. Druids begin the solar purging ritual. The Horned Fiend thrashes in agonizing torment.
  • 11:30 AM: 💥 DEAFENING SOUL DETONATION! The Horned Fiend is executed; its trapped angelic soul detonates in a 300-foot blast (70 radiant/fire dmg, heard across all hexes!).

# Room-by-Room Layout

  1. Room 1: The Razor Briar Perimeter & Thorny Thicket
  • Description: A dense wall of tangled blackthorn and blood-brambles 20 feet high. Thorns 3 inches long drip with acidic green sap.
  • Creatures: 2x Briarwood Displacer Beast
  • Hazard/Trap: Razor Thorns: Forcing through the briars deals 4d6 piercing and DC 13 Con save or poisoned for 1 hour. Can be burned with fire or pacified by Speak with Plants.
  • Secrets/Loot: Druid Scout Cache: Hollow oak trunk containing 3 vials of Antitoxin and a Cloak of Elvenkind.
  1. Room 2: The Scorched Clearing & Ozone Crater
  • Description: A 60-foot smoking impact crater in the center of the mossy forest floor. Soil is vitrified into black glass, and silver-white glowing ichor trails lead toward the ancient tree.
  • Creatures: 1x Elder Redwood Owlbear
  • Hazard/Trap: Ozone Arcs: Electrical arcs discharge from the crater every 3 rounds (DC 13 Dex save or 2d8 lightning damage).
  • Secrets/Loot: ⭐ Celestial Ichor: Smelling or examining the silver ichor (DC 12 Arcana/Religion) reveals it smells of frankincense and ozone rather than brimstone—a puzzling anomaly on early loops!
  1. Room 3: Archdruid Faelan's Binding Circle
  • Description: Twelve standing stones carved with nature runes surround the clearing. Six druids in antler masks channel crackling green and golden lightning into iron chains.
  • Creatures: 4x Druid Circle Channelers
  • Hazard/Trap: Binding Lightning: Touching the chains connecting the standing stones deals 3d10 lightning damage (DC 14 Dex save for half).
  • Secrets/Loot: Faelan's Journal: Notes that "Lord Aurelius the Radiant" personally visited the grove at 07:00 AM, warning that the horned beast would destroy the forest unless executed by 11:30 AM.
  1. Room 4: The Heartwood Altar of the Elder Weirwood
  • Description: An immense weirwood tree whose carved face weeps scarlet sap. Bound against its trunk in thorns is the terrifying Horned Fiend—its eyes streaming with pure glowing tears.
  • Creatures: 1x Horned Fiend (The True Angel)
  • Hazard/Trap: 11:30 AM Soul Detonation: If killed, struck with the Crucible Charm, or executed by the Druids at 11:30 AM, the trapped soul detonates in a 70 radiant/fire blast, wiping out Hex (7,6) and prompting Old Jonas's 8-line rhyme at the start of the next loop ("First east to the ice, then south to the sand...").
  • Secrets/Loot: ⭐ The Inversion Touch Rite (Requires Boss 2 Tablets): On early loops, speaking Celestial only elicits agonized, incoherent fragments ("Father of Dawn... forgive them... the feathers burn...") because of planar inversion shock. Once the party recovers the Golden Alabaster Tablets (Stanza IV) from the Sunken Necropolis (Hex 12, 16), presenting the tablets and speaking the True Celestial Name halts the 11:30 AM detonation, restores the True Angel's coherent speech, and allies both the Angel and Archdruid Faelan's circle!

  • Armor Class: 11
  • Hit Points: 36 (8d8)

# 14.3 Blazing Farmland Firebreak & Cinder Mephits (CR 1/2)

  • Encounter Location: Hex (7, 10) — Blazing Farmland (1 hex West of Beregost).
  • Narrative Context: Before dawn (~05:25 AM), the party accidentally dropped their Burning Book in Old Branden's barleyfield on their walk into town, igniting a massive 600-acre wildfire. While stone irrigation canals protect Beregost, a 60-foot stand of dry cedar windbreak trees threatens to carry flames across the eastern ditch into Baker Tobias's sourdough barley shed. Two Cinder Mephits born from the planar book's sparks harass Old Branden and the bucket brigade.
  • Official D&D 2024 (5.5e) Stat Block (2x Cinder / Magma Mephits):
  • Size / Type: Small Elemental, Neutral Evil
  • Armor Class: 12
  • Hit Points: 22 (5d6 + 5) each
  • Speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft.
  • Proficiency Bonus (PB): +2
  • Ability Scores: STR 8 (-1), DEX 12 (+1), CON 12 (+1), INT 7 (-2), WIS 10 (+0), CHA 10 (+0)
  • Damage Vulnerabilities: Cold
  • Damage Immunities: Fire, Poison
  • Condition Immunities: Exhaustion, Poisoned
  • Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., Passive Perception 10
  • Traits:

  • Actions (D&D 2024 Format):
  • Claws: Melee Attack Roll: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.
  • Fire Breath (Recharge 6): Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, 15-ft. Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
  • Firebreak Containment Mechanics & Clue:
  • Chopping the Containment Line: Felling the dry cedar windbreak before the fire jumps the ditch requires three DC 13 Strength (Athletics) checks using woodaxes (or dealing 30 slashing/force damage to the windbreak trees, or casting Create Water / Gust of Wind along the trench).
  • Why the Book Cannot Be Found on Foot: Venturing past the firebreak into the 600-acre burning barleyfield inflicts 3d6 Fire damage per 10 minutes and Heavily Obscured blinding smoke. Old Branden tells the party: "Whatever glowing relic started this blaze fell right in the middle of the dark furrows before dawn—you'll never find it on foot in 600 acres of smoke, only from the sky before the fire spread!"
  • Reward: Tobias gifts the party his Baker's Warmth Loaf (+5 Temp HP & Cold Resistance) and the Subterranean Flour-Chute Key, and reminds them to be back in Beregost by 11:00 AM for the High Sun Muster!

🔔 The Official Dawn Monologue (06:00 AM)

"You hear a sharp, heavy CLACK as the clock ticks forward to 6:00 AM. A great bronze bell strikes—GONG. In your hand, the pale bone that jammed the mechanism crumbles, dissolving into a fine gray dust that slips through your fingers.

The morning air is crisp and cool. The town square down below you stirs to life: a baker emerges with a steaming tray of honey-currant rolls, a little girl skips past the well tossing a carved wooden thrush into the air, a haggard old man sits up, wrapped in a patched quilt, and merchants unfurl colorful festival banners across the cobblestones.

Beyond the rooftops, the morning horizons stretch wide: to the north, crows scatter over the green forest canopy; to the east, snowy peaks glint white; to the south, ribbons of dust lift off desert dunes; and far to the west, low thunder rumbles over the sea.

It is dawn, and the sun sets in 12 hours.

Down in the square, a town guard shields her eyes, calling up to you standing on the rubbled, destroyed clocktower balcony with a wide grin:
'Hey! You got the clock working! Thank you! Happy Solstice!'"

Read aloud verbatim at 05:59 AM in Session 1 and at every 06:00 AM loop reset.
17:59 PM — The West Sea Cliffs Solar Detonation & Loop Reset 🔍 View Cataclysm Art

📜 The Solstice Prophecy of Beregost

The 8-Line Dawn Chant, The Complete Ulcaster Codex & The Townsfolk Investigation Trail
The 8 Sacred Lines (Dawn Street Chant): 4 Rhyming Couplets • Old Jonas's Street Rhyme
With six chimes the belfry wakes, But doom is coming with no escape. Only one narrow path can provide salvation, Threading this needle stops the devil's elation. First east to the ice, then south to the sand, Find the path to stop the devil's hand. Blame not the angel for he is confused, Led astray by the fiendish ruse.
🎭 The Street Prophet's Roadmap & The Two-Phase Epiphany:
"First east to the ice, then south to the sand, find the path to stop the devil's hand. Blame not the angel for he is confused, led astray by the fiendish ruse."

• Phase 1 (Loops 1–7 — What the Party Believes): The party awakens on Loop 2 having suffered the 11:30 AM Ash Grove explosion. They still do NOT know of the body swap! Hearing Jonas chant "Blame not the angel for he is confused," they assume the radiant angel dragging down the sun on the Western Sea Cliffs is merely confused and mourning, and that a sinister devil is orchestrating the doom. To stop the devil's hand, the prophecy explicitly orders their steps: First East to the ice (Boss 1: White Dragon Rimefang) to claim the Wish of Frozen Heart, and Then South to the sand (Boss 2: Sunken Necropolis of Akh-en-Amon)!

• Phase 2 (Loop 8 — The Revelation in the Pharaoh's Crypt): Only deep inside the Sunken Necropolis (Hex 14, 12 / 12, 16), upon slaying Akh-en-Amon and recovering the Golden Alabaster Tablets of the Complete Solstice Codex, is the full truth unsealed! The scripture clarifies that the "fiendish ruse" was woven by none other than "Aurelius the Radiant" (Lord Ravana the Rakshasa), and that the bodies were swapped in the arcanist's planar battery: the hunted horned beast in the woods was the True Angel all along, and the singing seraph on the cliffs is the Archdevil! "The tiger guy has been playing us the entire time—it's the exact other way around!"

The Four Corners Solution Matrix:
⚖️ CENTER: The Two Swapped Souls Core Mystery

"Blame not the angel for he is confused... led astray by the fiendish ruse."
Reveals the soul-swap AND why the True Angel (in the Horned Fiend's body at 7,6) violently attacks the party: he is literally confused by Lord Ravana's Delirium Hex, and only snaps out of it once the Rakshasa (10,6) is defeated!

🏔️ EAST: Adult White Dragon (Rimefang) Hex 17, 10 | CR 13

"Slay the white wyrm for his chart / To claim a wish of frozen heart."
Slaying Rimefang yields his Glacial Treasure Chart, uncovering Djinni Zephyrus at (11, 12). Freeing the genie grants a Wish of Frozen Heart (thermal protection & escapement freeze).

🏜️ SOUTH: Mummy Lord (Akh-en-Amon) Hex 12, 16 | CR 15

"South: sunken tombs of sand reveal / Two traded souls a touch must heal."
The Sunken Necropolis contains the ancient alabaster tablets detailing the Inversion Reversal Rite. Touching the True Angel with sacred unguents wakes its divine memory!

🌲 NORTH: The Rakshasa (Lord Ravana) Hex 10, 6 | CR 13

"North: pierce the striped fiend’s holy guise / His true name binds his web of lies."
Lord Ravana poses as 'Aurelius the Radiant Deva.' Uncovering his True Name in the Mirage Pavilion shatters his illusion and forces his compliance.

🌊 WEST: Storm Giant (Tempest Lord Otheus) Hex 5, 11 | CR 13

"West: break the deep-sea giant’s chain / To drag the singing wings to rain."
Rescuing the chained Herald of Otheus on the Beached Caravel (5,11) and defeating him in a lightning-lashed duel on the pitching ship deck restores his sanity—he blows his Storm-Conch to summon Tempest Lord Otheus and the 17:30 PM Cat-5 Supercell Storm!

📖 The Complete Solstice Codex: Canticle of the Inverted Souls

Transcribed from the Alabaster Tablets of Ulcaster Scriptorium & Beregost Municipal Archives
Full Unabridged Text
[STANZA I: THE AWAKENING DAWN & THE NARROW PATH (OLD JONAS'S STREET CHANT)] With six bronze chimes the belfry wakes, But doom is coming with no escape. Only one narrow path can provide salvation, Threading this needle stops the devil's elation. First east to the ice, then south to the sand, Find the path to stop the devil's hand. Blame not the angel for he is confused, Led astray by the fiendish ruse. [STANZA II: THE GREAT DECEPTION & THE UNMASKING OF AURELIUS] The "devil's ruse" is woven in gold, By a striped deceiver, cruel and bold. Lord Ravana struts in the saint's attire, Posing as "Aurelius," born of fire! Look not to golden feathers for a righteous heart, Nor slay the weeping horned beast that bleeds apart. The angel's weeping soul inside the fiend is bound, While devil's malice struts upon the holy ground! If mortal blades should strike the weeping beast in dread, The devil's triumph seals, and hope of dawn is dead! [STANZA III: THE EASTERN WYRM & THE GENIE'S BREATH] Slay the white wyrm upon the glacial peak for chart, To free the Lord of Air and claim the Frozen Heart. His wish shall cool the burning gears before they bind, And grant the breath of winter to the mortal mind. [STANZA IV: THE SOUTHERN TOMBS & THE INVERSION RITE] South: sunken tombs of shifting sand reveal Two traded souls an alabaster touch must heal. Within the pharaoh’s crypt the ancient scrolls impart: The sacred word that severs flesh and swaps the heart. [STANZA V: THE NORTHERN MASQUERADE & THE TIGER'S MOCKERY] North: pierce the striped fiend’s radiant and holy guise, His secret name commanded binds his web of lies. The Rakshasa shall urge you on to slay the beast— Beware his gilded tongue before the solstice feast! [STANZA VI: THE WESTERN HURRICANE & BREAKING THE CYCLE] West: break the deep-sea giant’s abyssal iron chain, To summon tempest winds and douse the skies in rain. Four corners mend the falling sun and turn the key: Restore the angel's form, and set the morning free!
💡 DM Tactical Note on the Complete Codex:
When the players assemble or read the Complete Codex, Stanza II completely shatters the Rakshasa's deception. It warns the party explicitly that killing the "horned beast" in the Ash Grove will doom Beregost permanently, and gives them the exact sequence required to ally with the True Angel and perform the Inversion Reversal Rite.

🔍 The Investigative Trail: How Players Discover the Complete Codex

The players begin by hearing Jonas's fragmented street chant at dawn. By speaking with Jonas and following breadcrumbs among key townsfolk, they discover that Jonas was an Ulcaster scholar whose expedition uncovered the ancient tablets in the Southern Desert—reinforcing the East to Ice $\rightarrow$ South to Sand progression without spoiling the body-swap twist before Boss 2:

1. Old Jonas the Rhymer (Municipal Well / Bakery)
Trigger: Warm bread, cider, or DC 12 Persuasion/Insight check.

"The verses I shout? Just the nursery rhymes! The scraps that didn't burn! The master's ledger... the stone tablets we dug out of the southern sands... the full scripture had six sacred stanzas! Scribe Vane in the Town Hall bought my expedition notes when I stumbled in half-dead!"

2. Scribe Vane (Town Hall / Civic Archives)
Trigger: Ask about Old Jonas's origin or ancient manuscripts.

"Old Jonas was Brother Jonas of the Ulcaster Academy! Five years ago he arrived with a charred Expedition Manifest & Stanza I–II Fragment. It proves the unabridged Golden Alabaster Tablets (Stanzas II–VI) remain sealed inside the Suncophagus of Akh-en-Amon at the Sunken Necropolis (Hex 12, 16)—and warns that the desert is lethal without the Wish of Frozen Heart from Frostpeak (Hex 17, 10)!"

3. Barnaby Feldepost (Feldepost's Inn)
Trigger: Talk to Barnaby over an ale about Jonas.

"I pulled poor Jonas half-frozen out of a snowdrift three winters back. He had a leather scroll-case, babbling about a weeping beast in the woods. Starving as he was, he traded a charcoal tomb-rubbing to Garrick the Fence in Shadow Alley for cheese and dry blankets."

4. Garrick the Fence (Cobbler's Lane & Shadow Alley)
Trigger: Shadow Alley cellar barter / DC 14 Thieves' Tools or 100 gp.

"Yeah, I kept Jonas's charcoal rubbing in my strongbox. It shows Stanza III's couplet ('South: sunken tombs of sand reveal / Two traded souls a touch must heal') and a map sketch of Zahir's camp at Hex (14, 12) leading to the Sunken Necropolis at Hex (12, 16), where the full Inversion Rite is carved in solid gold!"

5. Sister Althea (The High Hall of Lathander)
Trigger: Ask about the theological origin of the prophecy.

"Jonas's chants echo the forbidden 'Hymn of the Sundered Halos.' Our texts warn that an archdevil trapped in an angelic vessel will outwardly appear radiant and holy, while its heart burns with malicious mockery."

6. Aerie & Sluice Ruins (Hex 11, 12 / 12, 13) $\rightarrow$ Sunken Necropolis (Hex 12, 16)
Trigger: Explore Sluice Scriptorium (Hex 12, 13) & defeat Boss 2 at Hex (12, 16).

The ancient Netherese Sluice Ruins at Hex (12, 13) and Zahir's camp at Hex (14, 12) provide the translation cipher and map for Netherese solar-hieroglyphs, allowing the party to read the Golden Alabaster Tablets (Stanzas II–VI) inside Boss 2's Suncophagus Chamber at Hex (12, 16)—proving the Angel/Devil body swap, naming the Rakshasa, and unlocking +2 to tactical checks against the final boss!

7. Prophet Joshua & The Western Sea Caves (Hex 4, 10)
Trigger: Track bandits to Hex (4, 10) at low tide (06:00–10:00 AM) or interrogate Harbor Master.

"The false sun will burn the land, but the sea cannot burn!" Terrified by prophetic dreams of the 18:00 PM solar detonation, Joshua was duped by a hooded deceiver's 500 gp forged Town Hall bounty into scuttling the caravel to 'drown the skies.' Parleying with Joshua (DC 13 Insight / DC 14 Persuasion) reveals the Rakshasa's deception and yields the Abyssal Winch Key & Brass Tidal Tuning Fork to save the Herald of Otheus and summon Tempest Lord Otheus!

Chanted at 06:00 AM by Municipal Well • Complete Codex recovered in Sunken Necropolis (Hex 12, 16)
